metadata.description: Jonathan Meyerson's personal collection of AI agentic plugins — reusable, self-contained skills for agent runtimes.

plugins.name: review-tribunal
plugins.description: Adversarial code review plugin. Parallel Skeptics attack the implementation, parallel Advocates defend it, and a Judge rules on every finding by reading the code directly. Configurable tribunal size (1-2 pairs) with full model diversity across roles.
